why: guff runs exhaustruct_v5 on the v4 analyzer until the v5 port lands. v5 no longer reads the `exhaustruct:"optional"` struct tag: it reports the tag itself ("struct tag \"exhaustruct\" is not supported anymore, use comment directives", with a fix) and then reports the field the tag used to excuse, twice here. v4 honours the tag, so guff reports neither. docs/PHASE8-LEDGER.md exhaustruct #3, #4.
